WITH RECURSIVE owners(module_id,owner_id,depth) AS (
        SELECT m.module_catalogue_id,
          coalesce(nullif(btrim(m.teams_shared_source_module_id),''),m.module_catalogue_id),0
        FROM curriculum.modules m WHERE m.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT owners.module_id,btrim(m.teams_shared_source_module_id),owners.depth+1
        FROM owners JOIN curriculum.modules m ON m.module_catalogue_id=owners.owner_id
        WHERE coalesce(btrim(m.teams_shared_source_module_id),'')<>'' AND owners.depth<5
    ), delivery AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (module_id) module_id,owner_id
        FROM owners ORDER BY module_id,depth DESC)
    SELECT coalesce(o.id,s.id) AS id,delivery.module_id AS "moduleId",m.title,
        coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AS start,
        coalesce(o.status,s.status,'scheduled') AS status
    FROM delivery JOIN curriculum.live_sessions s ON s.module_catalogue_id=delivery.owner_id
    JOIN curriculum.modules m ON m.module_catalogue_id=delivery.module_id
    LEFT JOIN curriculum.live_session_occurrences o ON o.live_session_id=s.id
    WHERE lower(s.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')
      AND (o.id IS NULL OR lower(o.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded'))
      AND (o.id IS NOT NULL OR coalesce(s.repeat_pattern,'') IN ('none',''))
      AND lower(btrim(coalesce(o.status,s.status,'scheduled'))) NOT IN
        ('cancelled','canceled','completed','deleted','failed','superseded','awaiting-signature')
      AND coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime)>=%s
    ORDER BY coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime),coalesce(o.id,s.id)::text LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id,c.module_catalogue_id AS module_id,c.title,c.type,
    w.title AS section_title,c.settings_json->>'dueTiming' AS due_timing,quiz.quiz_id,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',p.kind,'passed',p.passed,
                                                  'componentId',p.component_ref,'quizId',p.quiz_ref)),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM "Learner".learner_progress_entries p
     WHERE p.learner_id=%s AND p.component_link_source IN ('direct','quiz_ref') AND p.kind<>'activity_event'
       AND (p.component_ref=c.id::text OR p.quiz_ref=quiz.quiz_id)) AS progress
    FROM curriculum.components c JOIN curriculum.modules m ON m.module_catalogue_id=c.module_catalogue_id
    LEFT JOIN curriculum.weeks w ON w.id=c.week_id AND w.module_catalogue_id=c.module_catalogue_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce((SELECT q.quiz_id::text FROM curriculum.quiz_component_links q
              WHERE q.component_id=c.id ORDER BY q.id LIMIT 1),c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId') AS quiz_id) quiz
    WHERE c.module_catalogue_id IN (SELECT home.module_id FROM (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT id, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("Training_plan"::jsonb)='array'
            THEN "Training_plan"::jsonb ELSE "Learning_plan"::jsonb END AS plan
        FROM enrolment."Created_users" WHERE id=%s
    ), assigned AS (
        SELECT entry->>'moduleId' AS module_id, true AS current_plan FROM source
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(plan)='array' THEN plan ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) entry
        UNION ALL
        SELECT coalesce(m.curriculum_module_id,nullif(m.module_ref,'')),
               jsonb_typeof(source.plan) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        FROM source
        JOIN "Learner".learners l ON l.enrolment_id=source.id
        JOIN "Learner".learner_training_plan_modules m ON m.learner_id=l.id
    )
    SELECT cm.module_catalogue_id,cm.title,bool_or(assigned.current_plan)
    FROM assigned JOIN curriculum.modules cm ON cm.module_catalogue_id=assigned.module_id
    WHERE (cm.deleted_at IS NULL OR COALESCE(cm.deleted_via_parent, '') <> '')
    GROUP BY cm.module_catalogue_id,cm.title
) home(module_id,title,current_plan)
                                    WHERE home.current_plan)
      AND c.type='assignment' AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.modules archived_module WHERE archived_module.module_catalogue_id=c.module_catalogue_id AND archived_module.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(c.deleted_via_parent, '') <> '' AND c.deleted_via_parent IN (archived_module.module_catalogue_id, archived_module.deleted_via_parent) AND c.deleted_at BETWEEN archived_module.deleted_at - interval '5 minutes' AND archived_module.deleted_at + interval '5 minutes'))
